title: Chapter 381 Guo Liang'S Scout
content:
Chapter 381 Guo Liang'S Scout

Wang Shuo immediately led everyone to retreat quickly.

10 warriors, well prepared, naturally would not be easily captured by them.

After returning to the base, Wang Shuo restored the enemy terrain detected on the sand table.

There were three places suspected to be the main base, and Wang Shuo informed everyone of this situation.

Then he made a strategic deployment.

Wang Shuo didn't know how much combat power the red side had integrated at present.

But on his side, 90% of the warriors have been twisted into a rope.

Wang Shuo summoned several warriors with outstanding wisdom.

Wang Shuo felt that these people were the kind of people who were brave and resourceful. If they were placed outside, they would definitely be a leader.

"Everyone, I have just told you what I have discovered. What do you think of it?"

Shanyue, who has heavy infantry, was the first to say: "Commander, I think we need more intelligence. Knowing ourselves and the enemy will help us win every battle. We are currently unable to grasp the movements of the enemy's army, which is quite disadvantageous."

"Oh? Shanyue, do you have any suggestions?"

"In the previous competition, I defeated a man named Guo Liang, who chose scouts."

Wang Shuo thought to himself that since this guy chose scouts, he was destined to go to investigate the enemy, but he didn't report to me in advance. It's really...

But then he thought again, maybe others are testing his command level, which is not impossible.

In this case, I will go and invite him in person!

Wang Shuo found Guo Liang's location through the sand table. At this time, he was resting in his base.

When he was teleported to Guo Liang's base, someone immediately surrounded him.

Hearing the movement of his men, Guo Liang quickly rushed over.

Seeing that it was Wang Shuo, Guo Liang was very surprised.

"Commander, what's the matter?" Guo Liang asked his generals to withdraw.

"Brother Guo's men are very vigilant!"

"Commander, you are too kind. We should be cautious when using troops!"

Wang Shuo nodded: "I came here this time to ask Brother Guo to go and investigate the enemy's movements. I wonder if Brother Guo has the confidence?"

Guo Liang thought for a moment and clasped his fists to Wang Shuo and said, "No problem."

Now is the time to use his expertise. If he doesn't go to investigate, will he be cannon fodder later?

Even if Wang Shuo doesn't come, Guo Liang plans to go to investigate after replenishing his troops.

The next morning, Guo Liang reported to Wang Shuo: "Commander, I have found out the situation. The main force of the red side is planning to go to the earth mother worm area to obtain resources."

Wang Shuo heard this and instantly had a countermeasure in his mind.

Wang Shuo had also explored the only way for the red side to go to the earth mother worm.

If the enemy moves the earth mother worm on a large scale, it will give the purple side an opportunity to take advantage of it.

Wang Shuo immediately summoned Zhang Ren and others to discuss.

Finally, they formulated a feasible strategy.

Besiege and attack the reinforcements.

First send people to attack the opponent's main base, force the opponent to return for reinforcements, and then eat up the opponent's reinforcements.

"Lord, I think we should still pay close attention to the opponent's movements and guard against the opponent's sneak attack on our main base."

"That's natural. We will immediately divide our troops into three groups. Lin Zhu will be responsible for besieging the enemy's main base, Ma Kai will be responsible for guarding the home, and Wang Shuo and Zhang Ren will be responsible for ambush."

The ambushing troops will fight with the enemy's main force, and Wang Shuo decided to go there in person to support them.

At this time, Guo Liang's reconnaissance troops, like nails, were hidden in various main passages, keeping a close eye on the enemy's movements at any time.

After the opposing large force set off, Wang Shuo also led everyone to ambush at the designated location.
